findings.reason: Standalone original-resolution screenshot shows the literal word ltwo in the title. Unlike conventional L2 shorthand, ltwo is a word-shaped serialization of the function-space name; the Statement and proof identify the intended space unambiguously as L^2. Restoring its math notation repairs this malformed title without changing the claim.

The standalone screenshot renders L2(R) cleanly as plain text. This is readable baseline function-space shorthand with no raw TeX, broken delimiter or lost mathematical content; changing it to formatted mathematics would be an optional typographic improvement.

correction: Changed only the title from Carleson maximal operator is strong ltwo to Carleson maximal operator is strong $L^2$.
